records.subject: ABTe3 compounds (A metal, B nonmetal)
records.quote: Through comprehensive first-principles calculations, we identify a group of synthesized Te-based ABTe3 (A is a metal and B a nonmetal element) compounds (bearing a perovskite formula but not a perovskite in nature), where the unique chemistry of Te allows the formation of organic-like molecules within the crystalline system, a unique feature that leads to phonon-glass lattice thermal conductivity (kappa L) and thus high thermoelectric efficiency in this family of materials.
